title: fix(projection): a late tool result of an earlier call keeps a thread waiting for its answer
why: Inside the changed activity arm of the thread projection, a block says last_revived_at tracks the status bump, so it must skip exactly the rows the bump skips, or the IN PROGRESS sort order reshuffles. The fix adds a new case the bump skips, so it had to keep the two in step.
adaptation: None. The fix's test file whole: it emits thread events through the bus and reads thread_summaries.status and the watchdog's running probe.
